edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. It governs your forward steps. - W Seismic Shove spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Gravity Field is 17s at rank 1, 13 at max — walk out the moment it drops and commit your all-in in that downtime. - His Q shield is on a 9s cooldown: poke it out before you burst. - Your W is 14s — spent on poke, the combo-breaker is gone. - Hold R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: A crashed wave pins Viktor under tower losing Hex Fragments while you wall-surf bot — the roam pays twice: a kill there, a stack denied here.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: W is 14 seconds at rank 1 — thrown as poke, you have no combo and no self-peel when his jungler shows or he steps onto you.

edits.before: Track Viktor’s Gravity Field: The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: His Arcane Storm is a channel on cast — your Q, W or E interrupts it. Poke out his 9s Q shield before committing, and fight outside Gravity Field.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan cross-map; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

edits.before: Before Viktor upgrades Death Ray he has weak waveclear and short range, so shove with Threaded Volley and poke him whenever he steps up. A W-E worked-ground root punishes him hard because he has no dash, only the Gravity Field zone which he can't place fast enough to save himself.

edits.before: Two items back Viktor hard: evolved Death Ray shreds waves and outputs relentless AoE DPS, and Chaos Storm plus Gravity Field zone you out of fights. Once he's online, stop dueling, respect his range, and rely on E minefield and Wall flanks rather than straight poke wars.
edits.after: Two items back Viktor hard: augmented Hextech Ray shreds waves and outputs relentless AoE DPS, and Arcane Storm plus Gravity Field zone you out of fights. Once he's online, stop dueling, respect his range, and rely on E minefield and Wall flanks rather than straight poke wars.

edits.before: Viktor is a scaling farmer who is weak before his Death Ray upgrade. Your Threaded Volley out-shoves his short-range early clear, and your poke out-ranges him, so pressure him off the wave from level 1. At level 3 your W Seismic Shove into worked-ground E Unraveled Earth is a clean root he can't escape; his Gravity Field is a slow zone, not an instant answer, so all-in when it's down.
edits.after: Viktor is a scaling farmer who is weak before his Hextech Ray augment. Your Threaded Volley out-shoves his short-range early clear, and your poke out-ranges him, so pressure him off the wave from level 1. At level 3 your W Seismic Shove into worked-ground E Unraveled Earth is a clean stun he can't escape; his Gravity Field is a slow zone, not an instant answer, so all-in when it's down.

edits.before: This is his window: at two items evolved Death Ray obliterates waves and pumps out sustained AoE, while Chaos Storm and Gravity Field zone you off your carries. Once he's online you can't win a straight poke war, so pivot to E minefield zoning and Weaver's Wall flanks, pick him before he sets up, and avoid standing in his laser lanes.
edits.after: This is his window: at two items augmented Hextech Ray obliterates waves and pumps out sustained AoE, while Arcane Storm and Gravity Field zone you off your carries. Once he's online you can't win a straight poke war, so pivot to E minefield zoning and Weaver's Wall flanks, and interrupt his channeled Storm with any of your CC.
